title: Macaroni Tuna Salad
description: This chilled macaroni salad recipe with tuna, mayonnaise, olives, and grape tomatoes makes an excellent side dish or a light and easy meal on its own.
ingredients: 2 (5 ounce) cans white tuna, drained and flaked
1 (5 ounce) jar pimento-stuffed green olives, drained

steps.text: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook elbow macaroni in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, about 8 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink; transfer to a bowl, then cool in the refrigerator.

Toss 1 cup mayonnaise, tuna, celery, and onion together in a large bowl until combined; stir in macaroni, remaining 1 cup mayonnaise, grape tomatoes, and olives. Season with salt and black pepper. Chill in the refrigerator for 1 hour.
